messages.content: How long will it take to travel from San Francisco to Los Angeles by car?

function.name: calculate_tip

message.content:
Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles typically takes around **5–6½ hours** under normal traffic conditions.

| Factor | Typical Impact |
|--------|----------------|
| Distance (I‑80 W + I‑580 E + US‑101 S / CA‑17 S) | ≈ 380–400 miles |
| Average highway speed | 60–70 mph (including brief stops) |
| Traffic & weather | Can add 30 minutes to an hour or more during rush hour, construction, or bad weather |

So if you leave early in the morning when congestion is light, expect roughly **5 hours**; leaving later or encountering heavy traffic could push the trip closer to **6½ hours**. Safe travels!
message.reasoning: The user asks about driving time between SF and LA. We can estimate based on distance (~383 miles) and typical speed ~65 mph average including stops maybe 5 hours. Provide approximate answer. No tool needed.
